# Lucachinou (Luca)

> 17-year-old French student learning AI to become an AI Engineer.
> Builds open-source projects: Machine Learning (PyTorch, TensorFlow, SpaCy), RAG assistant, server administration tools and bots.
> Main languages: Python, Rust and Java.

## Profile

- **Name**: Luca, known online as **Lucachinou**
- **Age**: 17 (born in 2009)
- **Role**: studying AI to become an AI Engineer, open-source contributor
- **Languages spoken**: French, English
- **Website**: https://lucachinou.github.io/

## Skills

- **Python**: Machine Learning (PyTorch, TensorFlow, SpaCy), RAG, automation, AI, bots
- **Java**: plugins and mods for Minecraft, back-end
- **JavaScript**: Discord bots (Node.js) and lightweight web interfaces
- **Rust**: system tools and performance

## Projects

- [Assistant](https://github.com/Lucachinou/Assistant) (Beta): source code of the AI
  assistant integrated into the portfolio. Python, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), Machine Learning.
- [House Pricing Regression](https://github.com/Lucachinou/House-pricing-regression) (Release):
  regression model predicting house prices from size only, built with PyTorch. Educational project.
- [Spam Classifier](https://github.com/Lucachinou/Spam-Classifier) (Release): classification
  model detecting scam/spam messages, especially from Discord. Python, PyTorch.
- [Singlecraft](https://github.com/Lucachinou/Singlecraft) (Beta): open-source web dashboard
  in Python for managing Minecraft servers: start, stop, restart and view live logs.
